pages.text: Put any flower in. Three days later it comes out a $(item)Pressed Flower$().

A hopper above or beside the press feeds it, and one below takes the pressed flowers out. A $(item)comparator$() reads how far along it is, and a redstone pulse pops a pressed flower out of the front.$(br2)A Pressed Flower keeps the look of the flower it was. Use it on the ground or on a wall to lay it there; up to four share one spot. Flowers that glowed still glow.
